scope: Opening summary of the 2023 Volkow and Blanco review of substance use disorders.

keyRecommendations.text: Medications have clinically significant benefit in opioid, nicotine, and alcohol use disorders; behavioural therapies in all SUDs; neuromodulation in nicotine use disorder.
Use a chronic care model and match intensity to severity, treating psychiatric and physical comorbidity.
Prevention aimed at social risks in childhood and adolescence can decrease risk.

clinicalBottomLine: Treat SUD as a chronic illness: medication for opioid, nicotine, and alcohol use disorders, behavioural therapy for all SUDs, and referral of severe cases to specialised care.
notableCaveats: Only the open summary in the PMC record was available, not the full article body.

source.title: Substance use disorders: a comprehensive update of classification, epidemiology, neurobiology, clinical aspects, treatment and prevention.
